message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts: illegal discharge of waste water containing heavy metals (chromium, nickel) exceeding standards, no treatment, directly discharged to sewage. This is environmental pollution crime: illegal discharge of pollutants into water bodies, violating environmental protection law. In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "非法排放污染物罪" (illegal discharge of pollutants). Could be "非法排放废水罪" or "非法排放危险废物罪". Since heavy metals are hazardous, but typical charge: "非法排放污染物罪" (Article 338 of Criminal Law). So answer: [罪名]非法排放污染物罪<eoa>. Possibly also "污染环境罪". In examples they used "非法排放污染物罪" as phrase? Not seen earlier. But similar to "非法排放危险废物罪". The facts: waste water with heavy metals, not treated, discharged. So crime: "非法排放污染物罪". Provide as single.
